cases.query: What safe file writing pattern protects stored records?

cases.query: What maintenance failure occurs when the search index is old?
cases.body: Maintenance failure marks status stale when the search index age exceeds threshold.

cases.query: What size limit governs an ingest batch?
cases.body: Ingest batch fact enforces a conservative limit of five hundred telemetry samples.

cases.query: What batching preference reduces retry cost?
cases.body: Publishing preference favors many small batches over a few large payload uploads.

cases.query: Which record status is accepted as canonical truth?
cases.body: Canonical truth decision accepts only records whose status is confirmed.

cases.query: What does the client SDK project currently cover?
cases.body: SDK project state ships generated clients for three languages with shared retry logic.

cases.query: Where is the external Orbit corpus located?
cases.body: External corpus environment reads Orbit notes from a read-only mirror directory.

cases.query: How does the correction workflow preserve truth during crashes?
cases.body: Correction pattern writes the confirmed replacement before superseding old truth.

cases.query: What data quality failure does maintenance deduplicate?
cases.body: Data quality failure is duplicate telemetry rows competing in canonical storage.
